runners.name: SPANISH LAD

runners.name: LERADO

runners.name: KASUKEDO
runners.comment: Racing well recently. At the latest run 3rd in a small field at this track on July 22 over 1550m, 3.5 len behind Whats The One Code with 56.5kg at $2.30. runners.name: TARZADOR

runners.name: SON OF RED
runners.comment: Has only been in the placings once from seven starts. Last raced when sixth over 400m at Warragul six days ago. Prefer in something easier.

runners.name: LITTLE WEASEL
runners.comment: Didn't finish two back and couldn't make the frame last time when she finished last on July 22 over 525m at The Meadows behind Kiwi Evoca beaten 14 lengths (31.26) in a Maiden H. Major threat on best form.

runners.name: MINTER DELICIOUS
runners.comment: Last start finished 6th over 350m at Traralgon beaten 6 lengths (20.93) behind Rio Bon Bon in a Restricted WIN on July 17. Below best last time but looks well placed here. Deserves another chance.

runners.name: LONGINIDIS

runners.name: PLATINUM PATCH

runners.name: DARE YOU
runners.comment: At the latest run 9th of 11 at this track on July 9 over 1300m, 5 len behind Bit Of A Dagg carrying 52.5kg at $75.80. runners.name: MILLENNIUM MAGIC

runners.name: MACALISTER ABBY

runners.name: MARBLE SUNSET
runners.comment: Has shown little speed out of the boxes and drifts back in her races. The latest effort was a 9 length fifth over 400m at Warragul. Will need to improve to feature.

runners.name: AKINA RUPEE
runners.comment: Drawn the inside alley. Latest effort finished 6th on July 26 over 435m at this track behind Apex Legend beaten 6 lengths (25.13) in a Maiden. Well placed and among the chances here.

runners.name: BEAR HUNT
runners.comment: Has raced seven times and is overdue for a win, the latest offering a third (20.69) over 350m at Traralgon. Looks well placed here.

runners.name: JUMBUK MABIOR
runners.comment: Was out of the placings at final run of last campaign, finishing seventh (27.93) at Warragul before going for a three-and-a-half months spell. Prepared to watch this time.

runners.name: SOUL SECRET
runners.comment: At the last outing finished 4th over 400m at Warragul beaten 6 lengths (23.82) behind Hey Brad in a Rank Limit - Maiden on July 23. Looks a solid hope.

runners.name: COMANCHE CHIEF
runners.comment: Latest effort finished 7th in a Mix 6/7 on July 26 over 435m at this track behind Milly Lily beaten 7 lengths (25.15). Expected to go very well.

runners.name: TAYLOR'S GIRL
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage fifth last time out over 350m at Traralgon. Likely to find this too tough.

runners.name: KANE IT DIESEL
runners.comment: Has been in the minor money the last two runs, the latest at big odds finishing third (25.00) at Traralgon. Drawn close to the inside. Cannot be ruled out.

runners.name: DR. NAKITA
runners.comment: Won two starts back when well in the market at Traralgon over 425m. Last start finished 3rd over 350m at Traralgon beaten 2.5 lengths (20.47) behind Be My Tiger in a Mix 6/7 on July 24. Thereabouts of late and rates highly this line-up. Expected to be in the finish.

runners.name: NANDO BLAST
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage seventh last time out over 350m at Traralgon. Cannot enthuse on this occasion.

runners.name: BIG BRUCE
runners.comment: Hasn't shown any early speed lately and tends to spot them a start in his races, The latest effort was a 13 length seventh over 460m at Warragul. Better off looking to others.

runners.name: ADA'S HAND
runners.comment: Finished third last start (23.62) at big odds over 400m at Warragul. Drawn wide. Top-three aspirations.

R:CBG:3:2026-07-29.comment: 3. CONFECTIONIST has all the form on the board, and makes her poly track debut on her home track. SNOW WATCH makes his debut with plenty of trial experience under his belt, including a recent Avondale hit-out just over a week ago. Follow the market moves. 1. HEAVY IS THE CROWN has not had all the favours this prep after placing in both his runs during his initial campaign. Stick with him. 2. AWAKEN raced out of his class here last week and did not do much. He is better placed in this, and he is worth including in all top 4 combos.

runners.name: SNOW WATCH
runners.comment: Two-year-old gelding making debut by Ribchester out of Stormy Georgia. Purchased for NZD $ 4,100 (NZB 2025 National Online Yearling Sale). Was second in an Avondale barrier trial over 800m July 21. Worth watching despite a tricky gate.

runners.name: TOSS
runners.comment: Third race start today. At debut, got back early 5th of 10 at this track on June 17 over 970m, 4 len behind Smashing Sister with 53.5kg at $5.90. Last start 4th of 9 at Arawa Park on July 1 over 1215m, on heavy track; 7 len behind Gin And Bare It carrying 54.5kg at $10.50. Heading the right way and looks ready to win.

runners.name: CONFECTIONIST
runners.comment: Form hard to fault. Most recently 4th in a small field at Avondale on July 15 over 1200m, on a wet track; 6 len behind Gin And Bare It carrying 55.5kg at $5.60. The run before that sat on the speed and boxed on steadily 2nd of 10 at Tauranga on May 29 over 1400m, head behind Integrity carrying 57.5kg at $5. Nicely placed and gets her chance to bounce back.

runners.name: HEAVY IS THE CROWN
runners.comment: Returns from a 38-day let-up. At the latest run ran second last of 7 at Awapuni Synthetic on June 21 over 1300m, 7 len behind It's Amelia carrying 58.5kg at $3.90. Before that 5th of 11 at this track on June 3 over 1300m, 1.75 len behind La Cadiere carrying 55.5kg at $8.40. Better than the last run suggests and can make amends.

runners.name: HONEYDAZE
runners.comment: Second-up. First-up after seven months 6th of 9 at this track on July 9 over 970m, 8 len behind Ebony Gem carrying 52.5kg at $43. Previously second-up 10th of 13 at Arawa Park on November 16 over 1400m, slow going 3 len behind Burnished carrying 52kg at $58.60. Not keen on her chances.

runners.name: AWAKEN
runners.comment: At the latest run ran second last in a small field at this track on July 22 over 1550m, 6 len behind Altiplano with 57kg at $57.20. The start before that 9th of 11 at Te Aroha on July 5 over 1400m, on a wet track; 20 len behind Drommy with 57.5kg at $55.90. Well placed and can do much better.

runners.name: MOJO JOJO
runners.comment: Finished third last start (23.37) over 400m at Gawler. Will need a little luck early from the draw. One of the better hopes.

runners.name: FLAMINGO GIRL
runners.comment: Ran a fair race on debut when fourth (17.57) at this track over 300m. Likely to be much improved. With a good start will take catching.

runners.name: QUEEN FLOW
runners.comment: Is a eight start maiden overdue for a win, hitting the frame last start when third (17.42) over 300m at this track. Was on pace and game in defeat. Will need some luck to feature.

runners.name: KICK TO KICK
runners.comment: First starter by Ferdinand Boy from She's Shrewd. From the Craig Jaensch kennel. Keep a close eye on the market.

runners.name: TURBO AVERY
runners.comment: First race starter by Stout Monelli X Adele's Entity. Nicely drawn and should have early pace in a very open race. Watch for any market in this race with a number of chances.

runners.name: QUICK FIFTY

runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage seventh last time out over 366m at this track. Looks up against it this time.

runners.name: JAKARI BRITT
runners.comment: Has only been in the placings once from 12 starts. Last raced when third over 300m at Q Straight a couple of days ago. Looks a solid hope.

runners.comment: Has ability but remains a maiden after four starts, the most recent effort a fourth (20.62) over 366m at this track. Gave a big sight after racing on the speed much of the way. Has to be included.

runners.name: QUICK FIFTY
runners.comment: Has ability but remains a maiden after eight starts, the most recent effort a seventh (19.74) over 350m at Q Straight. Top chance to get off the mark.

runners.name: ROADWORK
runners.comment: Last start finished 5th on July 19 over 366m at this track behind Hara's Clegane beaten 4 lengths (20.32) in a Maiden. The last run is a strong form reference. Follow up.

runners.comment: Was out of placings last time when sixth (20.74) at Q Lakeside in a Maiden. Will jump from box 4 for the first time. Will need the right run.

runners.name: JAKARI BRITT

runners.comment: At the latest run tracked the speed and boxed on steadily; won by a nose at Ruakaka July 11 over 1600m in soft going defeating Bourbon Proof carrying 59kg at $5.20. runners.name: SPANISH LAD
runners.comment: Comes off a 42 day let-up. Most recently 7th of 11 at this track on June 17 over 1550m, 5 len behind Lerado carrying 58kg at $7.70. runners.name: LERADO
runners.comment: At the latest run ran second last of 7 at this track on July 9 over 1550m, 6 len behind Prometheus carrying 60kg at $4.20. Before that won by a head at this track June 17 over 1550m defeating Mister Meaner carrying 57.5kg at $5.10. Goes well here and is sure to prove hard to beat.

runners.name: KASUKEDO
runners.comment: Racing well recently. At the latest run 3rd in a small field at this track on July 22 over 1550m, 3.5 len behind Whats The One Code with 56.5kg at $2.30. runners.name: TARZADOR

runners.name: SON OF RED
runners.comment: Has only been in the placings once from seven starts. Last raced when sixth over 400m at Warragul six days ago. Prefer in something easier.

runners.name: LITTLE WEASEL
runners.comment: Didn't finish two back and couldn't make the frame last time when she finished last on July 22 over 525m at The Meadows behind Kiwi Evoca beaten 14 lengths (31.26) in a Maiden H. Major threat on best form.

runners.name: MINTER DELICIOUS
runners.comment: Last start finished 6th over 350m at Traralgon beaten 6 lengths (20.93) behind Rio Bon Bon in a Restricted WIN on July 17. Below best last time but looks well placed here. Deserves another chance.

runners.name: LONGINIDIS
runners.comment: Last start finished 4th over 425m at Traralgon beaten 10 lengths (25.28) behind Dr. Nakita in a Maiden on July 20. Capable of a strong show.

DARE YOU was beaten by a bad draw when making his track debut here nearly 3 weeks ago, and he is worth another chance from the pole position this time.

runners.name: FRENCH FOX

runners.name: PLATINUM PATCH
runners.comment: At the latest run failed to make an impression; 9th of 14 at Arawa Park on July 1 over 1400m, on heavy track; 7 len behind Chappy carrying 58.5kg at $51.20. runners.name: DARE YOU

runners.name: TRALAE MAN
runners.comment: Resuming after a three months break. Not seen since he finished last of 11 at Pukekohe May 1 over 1600m, soft track; 18 len behind Why Daddy with 57.5kg at $64.10. runners.comment: Finished third last start (23.62) at big odds over 400m at Warragul. Drawn wide. Top-three aspirations.

She has her first decent gate, and we are expecting her to figure in the top 3 this time. 6. SNOW WATCH makes his debut with plenty of trial experience under his belt, including a recent Avondale hit-out just over a week ago. Follow the market moves. 1. HEAVY IS THE CROWN has not had all the favours this prep after placing in both his runs during his initial campaign. Stick with him. 2. AWAKEN raced out of his class here last week and did not do much. He is better placed in this, and he is worth including in all top 4 combos.

runners.name: SNOW WATCH
runners.comment: Two-year-old gelding making debut by Ribchester out of Stormy Georgia. Purchased for NZD $ 4,100 (NZB 2025 National Online Yearling Sale). Was second in an Avondale barrier trial over 800m July 21. Worth watching despite a tricky gate.

runners.name: TOSS
runners.comment: Third race start today. At debut, got back early 5th of 10 at this track on June 17 over 970m, 4 len behind Smashing Sister with 53.5kg at $5.90. Last start 4th of 9 at Arawa Park on July 1 over 1215m, on heavy track; 7 len behind Gin And Bare It carrying 54.5kg at $10.50. Heading the right way and looks ready to win.

runners.name: CONFECTIONIST
runners.comment: Form hard to fault. Most recently 4th in a small field at Avondale on July 15 over 1200m, on a wet track; 6 len behind Gin And Bare It carrying 55.5kg at $5.60. The run before that sat on the speed and boxed on steadily 2nd of 10 at Tauranga on May 29 over 1400m, head behind Integrity carrying 57.5kg at $5. Nicely placed and gets her chance to bounce back.

runners.name: HEAVY IS THE CROWN
runners.comment: Returns from a 38-day let-up. At the latest run ran second last of 7 at Awapuni Synthetic on June 21 over 1300m, 7 len behind It's Amelia carrying 58.5kg at $3.90. Before that 5th of 11 at this track on June 3 over 1300m, 1.75 len behind La Cadiere carrying 55.5kg at $8.40. Better than the last run suggests and can make amends.

runners.name: HONEYDAZE
runners.comment: Second-up. First-up after seven months 6th of 9 at this track on July 9 over 970m, 8 len behind Ebony Gem carrying 52.5kg at $43. Previously second-up 10th of 13 at Arawa Park on November 16 over 1400m, slow going 3 len behind Burnished carrying 52kg at $58.60. Not keen on her chances.

runners.name: AWAKEN
runners.comment: At the latest run ran second last in a small field at this track on July 22 over 1550m, 6 len behind Altiplano with 57kg at $57.20. The start before that 9th of 11 at Te Aroha on July 5 over 1400m, on a wet track; 20 len behind Drommy with 57.5kg at $55.90. Well placed and can do much better.

runners.name: MOJO JOJO
runners.comment: Finished third last start (23.37) over 400m at Gawler. Will need a little luck early from the draw. One of the better hopes.

runners.name: FLAMINGO GIRL
runners.comment: Ran a fair race on debut when fourth (17.57) at this track over 300m. Likely to be much improved. With a good start will take catching.

runners.name: QUEEN FLOW
runners.comment: Is a eight start maiden overdue for a win, hitting the frame last start when third (17.42) over 300m at this track. Was on pace and game in defeat. Will need some luck to feature.

runners.name: KICK TO KICK
runners.comment: First starter by Ferdinand Boy from She's Shrewd. From the Craig Jaensch kennel. Keep a close eye on the market.

runners.name: TURBO AVERY
runners.comment: First race starter by Stout Monelli X Adele's Entity. Nicely drawn and should have early pace in a very open race. Watch for any market in this race with a number of chances.

runners.name: MIDNIGHT MONICA
runners.comment: Has ability but remains a maiden after four starts, the most recent effort a fourth (20.62) over 366m at this track. Gave a big sight after racing on the speed much of the way. Has to be included.

runners.name: QUICK FIFTY
runners.comment: Has ability but remains a maiden after eight starts, the most recent effort a seventh (19.74) over 350m at Q Straight. Top chance to get off the mark.

runners.name: ROADWORK
runners.comment: Last start finished 5th on July 19 over 366m at this track behind Hara's Clegane beaten 4 lengths (20.32) in a Maiden. The last run is a strong form reference. Follow up.

runners.name: AMALFI BLUE
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time when sixth (20.74) at Q Lakeside in a Maiden. Will jump from box 4 for the first time. Will need the right run.

runners.name: JAKARI BRITT
runners.comment: Has only been in the placings once from 12 starts. Last raced when third over 300m at Q Straight a couple of days ago. Looks a solid hope.

runners.name: SPANISH LAD
runners.comment: Comes off a 42 day let-up. Most recently 7th of 11 at this track on June 17 over 1550m, 5 len behind Lerado carrying 58kg at $7.70. runners.name: LERADO

runners.name: KASUKEDO
runners.comment: Racing well recently. At the latest run 3rd in a small field at this track on July 22 over 1550m, 3.5 len behind Whats The One Code with 56.5kg at $2.30. runners.name: TARZADOR
runners.trainer: G A & D Rogerson & C Isdale

runners.name: TAYLOR'S GIRL
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage fifth last time out over 350m at Traralgon. Likely to find this too tough.

runners.name: KANE IT DIESEL
runners.comment: Has been in the minor money the last two runs, the latest at big odds finishing third (25.00) at Traralgon. Drawn close to the inside. Cannot be ruled out.

runners.name: DR. NAKITA
runners.comment: Won two starts back when well in the market at Traralgon over 425m. Last start finished 3rd over 350m at Traralgon beaten 2.5 lengths (20.47) behind Be My Tiger in a Mix 6/7 on July 24. Thereabouts of late and rates highly this line-up. Expected to be in the finish.

runners.name: NANDO BLAST
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage seventh last time out over 350m at Traralgon. Cannot enthuse on this occasion.

runners.name: BIG BRUCE
runners.comment: Hasn't shown any early speed lately and tends to spot them a start in his races, The latest effort was a 13 length seventh over 460m at Warragul. Better off looking to others.

runners.name: ADA'S HAND
runners.comment: Finished third last start (23.62) at big odds over 400m at Warragul. Drawn wide. Top-three aspirations.

R:CBG:3:2026-07-29.comment: 3. CONFECTIONIST has all the form on the board, and makes her poly track debut on her home track. A good gate, and with Michael McNab keeping the faith, she is the one to beat. 4. TOSS has fewer convictions than most in this, and she will be peaking at her third career start. She has her first decent gate, and we are expecting her to figure in the top 3 this time. 6. SNOW WATCH makes his debut with plenty of trial experience under his belt, including a recent Avondale hit-out just over a week ago. Follow the market moves. 1. HEAVY IS THE CROWN has not had all the favours this prep after placing in both his runs during his initial campaign. Stick with him. 2. AWAKEN raced out of his class here last week and did not do much. He is better placed in this, and he is worth including in all top 4 combos.

runners.name: SNOW WATCH
runners.comment: Two-year-old gelding making debut by Ribchester out of Stormy Georgia. Purchased for NZD $ 4,100 (NZB 2025 National Online Yearling Sale). Was second in an Avondale barrier trial over 800m July 21. Worth watching despite a tricky gate.

runners.name: TOSS
runners.comment: Third race start today. At debut, got back early 5th of 10 at this track on June 17 over 970m, 4 len behind Smashing Sister with 53.5kg at $5.90. Last start 4th of 9 at Arawa Park on July 1 over 1215m, on heavy track; 7 len behind Gin And Bare It carrying 54.5kg at $10.50. Heading the right way and looks ready to win.

runners.name: CONFECTIONIST
runners.comment: Form hard to fault. Most recently 4th in a small field at Avondale on July 15 over 1200m, on a wet track; 6 len behind Gin And Bare It carrying 55.5kg at $5.60. The run before that sat on the speed and boxed on steadily 2nd of 10 at Tauranga on May 29 over 1400m, head behind Integrity carrying 57.5kg at $5. Nicely placed and gets her chance to bounce back.

runners.name: HEAVY IS THE CROWN
runners.comment: Returns from a 38-day let-up. At the latest run ran second last of 7 at Awapuni Synthetic on June 21 over 1300m, 7 len behind It's Amelia carrying 58.5kg at $3.90. Before that 5th of 11 at this track on June 3 over 1300m, 1.75 len behind La Cadiere carrying 55.5kg at $8.40. Better than the last run suggests and can make amends.

runners.name: HONEYDAZE
runners.comment: Second-up. First-up after seven months 6th of 9 at this track on July 9 over 970m, 8 len behind Ebony Gem carrying 52.5kg at $43. Previously second-up 10th of 13 at Arawa Park on November 16 over 1400m, slow going 3 len behind Burnished carrying 52kg at $58.60. Not keen on her chances.

runners.name: AWAKEN
runners.comment: At the latest run ran second last in a small field at this track on July 22 over 1550m, 6 len behind Altiplano with 57kg at $57.20. The start before that 9th of 11 at Te Aroha on July 5 over 1400m, on a wet track; 20 len behind Drommy with 57.5kg at $55.90. Well placed and can do much better.

G:MTS:1:2026-07-29.comment: 2. FLAMINGO GIRL was safely held on debut after settling well back when fourth (17.57) at this track over 300m. This looks easier and expected to improve sharply. 1. TURBO AVERY is a newcomer for the Tamica Dunn kennel with no trial form to work with. Gets her chance from the draw. Market should provide a lead to her ability. 4. MOJO JOJO jumps from box 4 again after finishing third (23.37) last time at Gawler over 400m. Solid beginner and with a good start can clear the tricky draw. Can measure up. 8. KICK TO KICK is a newcomer from the Craig Jaensch kennel. Start all important and will need some luck getting across from the wide draw. Can feature with the right run.

runners.name: MOJO JOJO
runners.comment: Finished third last start (23.37) over 400m at Gawler. Will need a little luck early from the draw. One of the better hopes.

runners.name: FLAMINGO GIRL
runners.comment: Ran a fair race on debut when fourth (17.57) at this track over 300m. Likely to be much improved. With a good start will take catching.

runners.name: QUEEN FLOW
runners.comment: Is a eight start maiden overdue for a win, hitting the frame last start when third (17.42) over 300m at this track. Was on pace and game in defeat. Will need some luck to feature.

runners.name: KICK TO KICK
runners.comment: First starter by Ferdinand Boy from She's Shrewd. From the Craig Jaensch kennel. Keep a close eye on the market.

runners.name: TURBO AVERY
runners.comment: First race starter by Stout Monelli X Adele's Entity. Nicely drawn and should have early pace in a very open race. Watch for any market in this race with a number of chances.

G:CPL:1:2026-07-29.comment: 7. QUICK FIFTY shows ability but remains a maiden after eight starts. Was below best last time when missed the frame finishing seventh (19.74) at Q Straight. The form from his last run stacks up well. Looks the one to beat on his best form. 2. ROADWORK comes off a moderate effort last start, finishing fifth at this track over 366m behind Hara's Clegane (20.32). Strong form has emerged from his last run. Better than the latest run and deserves another chance. 6. MIDNIGHT MONICA latest effort finished 4th in a Maiden on July 26 over 366m at this track behind Crystal Days beaten 10 lengths (20.62). Rates a key chance on best figures. 8. JAKARI BRITT is another with top-three prospects.

runners.name: MIDNIGHT MONICA
runners.comment: Has ability but remains a maiden after four starts, the most recent effort a fourth (20.62) over 366m at this track. Gave a big sight after racing on the speed much of the way. Has to be included.

runners.name: QUICK FIFTY
runners.comment: Has ability but remains a maiden after eight starts, the most recent effort a seventh (19.74) over 350m at Q Straight. Top chance to get off the mark.

runners.name: ROADWORK
runners.comment: Last start finished 5th on July 19 over 366m at this track behind Hara's Clegane beaten 4 lengths (20.32) in a Maiden. The last run is a strong form reference. Follow up.

runners.name: AMALFI BLUE
runners.comment: Was out of placings last time when sixth (20.74) at Q Lakeside in a Maiden. Will jump from box 4 for the first time. Will need the right run.

runners.name: NOT ROBINSON
runners.comment: Has not shown much in recent runs. Could only manage seventh last time out over 366m at this track. Looks up against it this time.

runners.name: DYNAMIC BANJO
runners.comment: Good performance to win by 2 lengths at Q Straight over 300m (16.80) beating It's Yama Time in Maiden on July 27. Can't recommend him in this.

runners.name: JAKARI BRITT
runners.comment: Has only been in the placings once from 12 starts. Last raced when third over 300m at Q Straight a couple of days ago. Looks a solid hope.
